Class Spinner

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.spinner.Spinner
All Implemented Interfaces:
StatefulWidget<SpinnerState>
public final class Spinner extends Object implements StatefulWidget<SpinnerState>
A widget that renders an animated spinner by cycling through frame characters.

The spinner displays one frame at a time, determined by the current tick in the SpinnerState. Each tick advances to the next frame in the sequence. 

// Create a spinner with the DOTS style
Spinner spinner = Spinner.builder()
    .spinnerStyle(SpinnerStyle.DOTS)
    .build();

// Create a spinner with custom frames
Spinner spinner = Spinner.builder()
    .frames("*", "+", "x", "+")
    .build();

// Create a spinner with a custom frame set
Spinner spinner = Spinner.builder()
    .frameSet(SpinnerFrameSet.of("⠋", "⠙", "⠹", "⠸"))
    .build();

  • Field Details

    • SPINNER_STYLE

      public static final PropertyDefinition<SpinnerStyle> SPINNER_STYLE
      The spinner-style property for selecting a predefined spinner style.

      CSS values are derived from enum names by converting to lowercase and replacing underscores with hyphens. For example:

      • dots - braille dot pattern (default)
      • line - classic -\|/
      • bouncing-bar - bouncing bar [=== ]
      • gauge - horizontal block fill
      This property is NOT inheritable. Default: SpinnerStyle.DOTS

    • SPINNER_FRAMES

      public static final PropertyDefinition<SpinnerFrameSet> SPINNER_FRAMES
      The spinner-frames property for custom spinner frame characters.

      Format: variable number of quoted strings representing the animation frames.

      Example: spinner-frames: "-" "\\" "|" "/"

      This property overrides spinner-style when set. This property is NOT inheritable.
